review.notes: Clean document; no repairs needed. Zero code-fence markers in the OCR Markdown, heading tree matches the printed Contents, no duplicated or spurious headings. The PDF is digital-native, so its text layer is authoritative; no value required visual re-verification and no patches were proposed. References [1]-[4] match the PDF word for word.
